text.tspan: PMDS prototype radio, step 3, sheet 1: RF input, low-pass filter, mixer and its clock
Low-pass filter, 2.2 MHz, 50 Ω (5-pole Butterworth). Use C0G capacitors:
C1 and C3 = 820 pF + 68 pF in parallel, C2 = 2.7 nF + 220 pF in parallel
U1 also: pin 6 (E) and pins 7, 8 to GND;
pin 3 (Y COM) to GND, Y0-Y3 unused;
pin 7 to GND; 100 nF from pin 14 to GND.
Q1 Q2 step 00, 10, 11, 01 on each clock, so X0, X1, X3, X2
each get a quarter of every oscillator cycle
